title: services.categories.update
description: Payload of commands/category_update.sql. Full snapshot; PARTIAL for callers via `records.category.patch` (hub#632): the runtime reads `services.categories.get` with `category_id` and completes the omitted keys before validating. Explicit `null` clears; omitted preserves. Closed contract (services#9).

category_id.description: Id of the category to update, of this hub.

slug.description: URL-safe key, unique per hub: lowercase, no spaces.

parent_id.description: Parent category of THIS hub, alive, or none (root). The statement checks ownership and liveness and refuses with `services.parent_category_unavailable`; a category cannot be its own parent (CHECK).
